architecture: SideStripNet normal-bin compression + local axial response/normal-offset heads
selection: official held-out page oracle IC bands; not end-to-end score

preparation.matching: one-to-one geometric IoU >= 0.3; no designator required; supervision preparation only
preparation.train_augmentation: original plus shared independent four-edge U(-6,6) perturbation; validation unperturbed
preparation.caveat: matched IC subset only; counts and optimization steps may differ; targets beyond 30px normal omitted and counted
